whatItDoes: Calculates VAT, GST, or Sales Tax for 35+ countries. Supports exclusive (tax added on top) and inclusive (tax included) modes, standard, reduced, and zero rates, and provincial/state breakdowns (e.g., Canada HST/GST+PST).
whyItExists: Tax rules vary worldwide—some regions quote prices inclusive of tax, others exclusive. Rates differ by country, province, and product type. A single calculator that knows each jurisdiction's rates and inclusive/exclusive conventions removes guesswork and manual errors.
whoShouldUse: International shoppers, cross‑border sellers, travelers, accountants, and anyone preparing invoices or estimating checkout totals across borders.
useCases: Estimate the final price of a product in another country
Extract the tax portion from a tax‑inclusive price (common in UK, EU, India)
Add the correct tax to an invoice for a foreign client
Break down Canadian HST into federal GST and provincial portions
Compare tax‑inclusive vs exclusive totals for budgeting
Verify a receipt's tax breakdown against local rates
instructions: Select the country (and province/state for Canada)
Choose the tax regime: exclusive (tax added) or inclusive (tax already in price) — the default follows local convention
Pick the applicable rate: standard, reduced, zero, or enter a custom rate
Enter the amount (pre‑tax for exclusive, total for inclusive)
Read the tax amount, base amount, and total
For Canada, optionally select a province to see federal vs provincial split
examples: Canada Ontario (exclusive): $100 at 13% HST → federal $5, provincial $8, total $113
bestPractices: Use the inclusive mode when the price you have already includes tax (common in EU, UK, India, Australia)
Select the correct reduced rate for the product category (e.g., food, books, medical)
For Canada, choose the province to automatically split HST/GST+PST
Verify the rate matches the product category and jurisdiction
Re‑check rates periodically; they change annually in many countries
commonMistakes: Using exclusive mode when the displayed price already includes tax
Applying the standard rate where a reduced or zero rate applies
Forgetting to split Canadian HST into federal and provincial portions
Entering the rate as a whole number (8) instead of percent (8%)
Applying tax twice by calculating on an already‑taxed amount
faq: Does this handle compound taxes? — Yes, for Canada it splits HST/GST+PST automatically; other countries use a single flat rate.
What is a reduced rate? — Many countries apply lower rates to essentials (food, books, medicine). Select the appropriate one from the dropdown.
Is the calculator up to date? — Rates reflect the latest published rates as of 2025; verify with local authority if critical.
Is my data shared? — No, everything runs locally in your browser.

How is VAT different from Sales Tax? — Both are consumption taxes; VAT is collected at each stage of production, Sales Tax only at final sale. The math for the end consumer is the same flat‑rate application.
assumptions: Country-specific VAT/GST/Sales Tax rates for 35+ countries. Includes standard, reduced, and zero rates with inclusive/exclusive modes. Canada province breakdown.
features: Standard, reduced, and zero rate selection
